ruleDefinitions.name: VMMap Unsigned Dbghelp.DLL Potential Sideloading
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of an unsigned dbghelp.dll by the Sysinternals VMMap. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded, Signed

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Debuggers\\\\dbghelp\\\.dll.*") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\vmmap\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vmmap64\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT (Signed = "true")
